what: SECOND RUN, the check of 2026-11-19 (session 253): for each of the 9 repeatable tests of a hosted model (the Field's model_access 'public product or API', check 82), one model it ran on that its maker has since retired, read on the maker's own deprecation page on 2026-11-19, and any model of it still offered.
